clips.title: The story
paras: In northern Silverpine, Ivar's Head proves Ivar the Foul is dead. Rane Yorick seeks it so her wounded brother Quinn can recover safely.

Rane and Quinn Yorick were scouting northern Silverpine Forest on High Executor Hadrec's orders when Ivar the Foul ambushed them at an abandoned farmstead. The Forsaken Deathstalkers drove the feral ghoul off, but Quinn was badly mauled. Rane stayed at the ruined farm to watch over him and could not safely leave to finish their mission. Ivar's severed head proves the ghoul will no longer threaten the estate, giving Quinn time to recover under Rane's care.
